title: Unified Token-Efficient DSL Syntax Across All Technologies
description: Unify syntax across all DSLs in the repo (dsl/ engine, mathematical/graph/dsl wire+Jack, vcs .ops header, trinity/ram legacy lexer, ~55 adopter crates). Target: maximum token/parser efficiency (schema stated once via SoA tables, implicit-preferred, bare strings), domain-intuitive syntax subsetting existing languages (SVG paths, Cypher), streaming/lazy-loadable layout (metadata first, statement-level incremental parse), and one consistent sigil set repo-wide: `:` typing, lowercase-kebab names, PascalCase domain kinds / UPPERCASE schema type tags, `--`/`->`/`<-` connections, `@` connection points, `_` placeholders, bare-preferred `""` strings. Compose's C# expression language is explicitly deferred to a follow-up ticket. Full design in /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-dsl-must-be-crispy-shell.md — Wave 0 engine (dsl/core, dsl/schema, dsl/derive, dsl facade, delete dsl/codec), Wave 1 choke points (vcs .ops, mathematical/graph/dsl wire+Jack), Wave 2 parallel adopter packages (P1-P10 covering all fixture-bearing crates), Wave 3 convergence gate (delete serde_json::Value DocumentDsl bridge, full verify).
summary:
Fixed both dsl_schema Shape::Table engine bugs flagged by this ticket's own Wave-2 sweep, then re-adopted #[dsl(table)] at every site that had worked around them.

Bug 1 (nested table-in-table): a Shape::Table reached anywhere other than a record's own leading keyword (a table row's own column, a list element, the generic key= dispatch) used to always print via the bare SoA form (print_table), which has no bracket of its own to mark where it ends — unparseable once nested. Fixed by giving that context its own dedicated bracketed, braced-row AoS form (`[ {row} {row} ... ]`), via new parse_table_list/print_table_list; only a record's own keyword-prefixed field still uses the bare `key [col:TYPE ...] {rows}` form.

Bug 2 (duplicate-same-type Record table columns): a bare Shape::Record table cell has no bracket of its own either (no key= prefix in SoA rows), so two adjacent columns of the same nested record type let one column's greedy key-matching swallow the next column's same-named token. Fixed by brace-wrapping every Record-shaped table cell on print and requiring braces on parse, via new print_table_cell/parse_table_cell.

Added two regression tests to dsl_schema's existing 🧪Tests region reproducing each bug exactly (table_row_containing_its_own_table_field_round_trips_without_desync, table_row_with_two_columns_of_the_same_record_type_does_not_cross_contaminate) and updated the AoS-verbose-input test to the now-required braced-row syntax. dsl_schema: 27/27 green; dsl/dsl_derive/dsl_token/vcs/mathematical_graph_dsl all still green (0 regressions).

Then re-adopted #[dsl(table)] at all 6 previously-reverted workaround sites (dispatched as parallel background agents, each independently verified via cargo test):
- norm/vdi/3805/rs: CatalogueProduct.records/accessories/components (43/43 green, +4 norm-plugin)
- norm/iso/16757/rs: Names.alternatives, plus populated the fixture with real alternatives data so the fix is actually exercised (43/45 green, 2 pre-existing-and-still-open ignores for an unrelated pack::value::decode_table_soa limitation; +4 norm-plugin)
- trinity/ram/rs: NodeDsl.ports, plus regenerated 2 .trinity example fixtures to the new braced syntax (57/57 green; trinity_rewrite 44/44, trinity-plugin 36/36, trinity_jack 21/21, trinity_jack_lsp 30/30, writer-plugin 37/37)
- layout/rs: TextStory.style_runs, plus regenerated its 1 example fixture (36/36 green, was 9 failing before; layout-plugin 35/39, 4 pre-existing unrelated icon-catalog failures)
- remodel/rs: MediaStream.frames and GroundControlPoint.observations (31/32 green, 1 pre-existing unrelated Pack-codec Tuple/List bug also reproduces with these changes reverted; remodel-plugin 22/23, 1 pre-existing unrelated icon-catalog failure)
- architect/program/rs: all 13 reverted Program register fields (elements/relationships/services/growth/conflicts/requirements/scenarios/decisions/assumptions/constraints/changes/issues/knowledge) — the exact duplicate-same-type-column corruption class, now clean (180/180 green; architect-plugin 11/11)

Final consolidated cross-crate test run confirms zero regressions and exact agreement with each site's own report.
